catalogRecord.title: Heavy metal contamination of water, sediments plankton, invertebrates and fish on three river mouths along Manila Bay: Navotas, Pasig and Zapote
catalogRecord.repository: De La Salle University Animo Repository
catalogRecord.shelfLocation: Archives, The Learning Commons, 12F, Henry Sy Sr. Hall
catalogRecord.onlineAvailabilityStatement: This document is currently not available here.

interpretation.whatTheRecordSupports: A bibliographic retrieval lead for a thesis whose title identifies fish as one study component and includes the Zapote river mouth among three Manila Bay river-mouth sites.
interpretation.whatItDoesNotSupport: No fish taxon, exact sampling station, survey date, method, specimen, current-presence, full river checklist, water-quality result or reusable data claim can be made from the catalog metadata alone.
interpretation.nextAction: Ask DLSU Libraries whether the print item can be consulted or whether an authorized scan of relevant fish methods/results pages is available; confirm reuse terms before transcribing any table or publishing derived records.

rightsAndUse.decision: Retain as a retrieval lead only. Do not derive species records from the title or catalog metadata.
